title: Class of Nine — PC competition and league operations
status: Research and proposed screen-specific redesign; no production implementation claimed
platform: PC only; mouse and keyboard first. Gamepad hints require implemented and tested bindings. No mobile layout target.
evidenceLimits: Visual observations are limited to the official screenshots and exact video frames described. No hands-on game evaluation. C9 approval, financial, restore, permission and data-completeness rules below are design proposals and existing repository constraints, not claims about reference games.
principles: Design a bounded game canvas around one dominant sporting task, not a page of website sections.
Share typography, color, selection and motion while varying each screen topology: fixture wall, paired matchup, worksheet, bracket, ceremony, matrix, ledger, review stage.
Use fixed frame with explicit chapters, paging or bounded pane scrolling; never conceal overflow or data merely to remove native scrollbar appearance.
At PC resolutions prioritize readable rows, pointer precision, keyboard focus and window/scale behavior over mobile stacking.
Retain Class of Nine forest, brass, cream, approved C9 gateway and restrained varsity type. Borrow hierarchy, not licensed logos, characters or exact visual trade dress.
Entry, pending review, disputed, accepted and unknown must look different. Reference-game spectacle cannot overwrite companion data authority.

implementationPriorities.title: Replace the shared web-page frame
implementationPriorities.scope: One PC viewport, top game chapters, contextual command strip, page-specific body regions; remove mobile navigation and mobile breakpoint compositions.
implementationPriorities.proof: Test 1366x768, 1920x1080 and 2560x1440, keyboard traversal, 125/150 percent scaling; preserve all actions and text.

implementationPriorities.title: Prove four genuinely different competition screens
implementationPriorities.scope: Implement schedule fixture wall, opposing-team prep broadcast, editable scorer room and accepted box-score record as a coherent fixture journey.
implementationPriorities.proof: One real synthetic fixture survives all four routes with exact identity, draft/error recovery and pending-versus-final authority.

implementationPriorities.title: Build operations from exact obligations
implementationPriorities.scope: Commission readiness matrix, version-bound result review, narrow operation preflight and recovery vault; reuse semantic controls rather than a generic card layout.
implementationPriorities.proof: Exercise missing, stale, denied, rejected and interrupted states; no fake ready status, optimistic acceptance or unsupported restore.

sources.title: NHL 25 official Franchise Deep Dive — hub screenshots
sources.observed: Inspected the Vancouver/Ottawa hub image: calendar ribbon above central opposing crests; projected goalies underneath; quick commands left and league leaders right. Background and oversized matchup lettering unify the screen.
sources.adaptation: Use opposing team identity for prep and a narrow week ribbon for schedule. The canvas belongs to the match, with ancillary information subordinate.
sources.evidenceType: Direct visual inspection of official embedded screenshot in browser, 2026-09-18. No hands-on game evaluation.

sources.title: NHL 25 official Franchise Deep Dive — box scores
sources.observed: Inspected official result images: scoreboard matrix for game selection; selected result has large team names aligned with period totals, FINAL label and broad destinations for events, team stats and stars.
sources.adaptation: Build a baseball line-score anchor with team-stat chapters. Use FINAL only for accepted or authoritative simulated results; this restriction is C9-specific.
sources.evidenceType: Direct visual inspection of official embedded box-score screenshots in browser, 2026-09-18. No hands-on.

sources.title: MLB The Show 25 — Fielding Feedback: Franchise Front Office Experience, 1:50
sources.observed: At 1:50 the official PlayStation video shows a wide free-agent table with rank/name/OVR/potential/position/age/bats/throws; a single outlined row carries selection. Week and budget remain above.
sources.adaptation: Make sport-relevant rows the primary plane for player and budget work. Share selection semantics, not identical page composition. C9 knowledge boundaries replace MLB rating assumptions.
sources.evidenceType: Direct visual inspection of official PlayStation video frame at 1:50 in browser, 2026-09-18; not hands-on.

sources.title: MLB The Show 25 — Fielding Feedback: Franchise Front Office Experience, 2:02
sources.observed: At 2:02 a player model fills the left; a response and action occupy the center; a separate right strip retains identity, demand and declined offer. The decision does not become a new generic dashboard.
sources.adaptation: Use bounded action stages where target identity, consequence and exact action can be read together. C9 permission, revision and restore restrictions are proposed safeguards, not sourced MLB behavior.
sources.evidenceType: Direct visual inspection of official PlayStation video frame at 2:02 in browser, 2026-09-18; not hands-on.
